title: Signal log

creation.briefMd: logBeacon returns a tagged line the hidden tests also run.

blocks.md:
## A log you keep

`logBeacon(name)` should return `beacon:name`. Print `beacon:north` then `beacon:east`.

Hidden tests call your function with other names. Do not only print two literals.

blocks.promptMd: If `logBeacon` only prints and returns nothing, a later test that reads the return gets…
> `logBeacon(name)` returns `beacon:name`. Print north then east, one per line.

description: Build a small log of signals you can keep working on.
